requirements_before_any_full_valid_execu: a separate reviewed and pinned runner that enforces the frozen serial case order and one-process limit
OS-enforced wall-clock and memory limits with effective limits, process exit status and peak RSS captured per case
the pinned full-input builder checked in CI without invoking the solver
the frozen JSONL case and contrast evidence records emitted with fail-closed handling

research_question: On the same frozen full-valid Forest10 and Census13 models, does the same strict-improvement add-only greedy rule produce meaningfully different Nominal and task-wise PESS resource sets as the unit-cost proxy budget increases above 3?
minimal_experiment: Reuse the two archived 10,000-task valid-only models and their existing model adapters; after separate authorization, run the same deterministic greedy backend at B=0,2,3,4,5 for each objective and dataset, then exactly re-evaluate both selected sets under both frozen objectives.

scope.split: official valid only; 10000 tasks per dataset, no subsampling
scope.candidate_universe: all archived workload-supported unordered pair candidates; 45 Forest10 and 78 Census13
scope.future_escalation: B=6 or any other budget is outside this protocol and needs a separately reviewed protocol and explicit execution authorization

immutable_software.source_note: The adapter and model source commits identify the software used to create the frozen valid-only inputs. They are distinct from the Issue #87 adapter file hash and the future run commit.

frozen_inputs.candidate_order_hash_method: SHA-256 of UTF-8 json.dumps(candidate_ids, separators=(',', ':')) with ensure_ascii=True
frozen_inputs.maintenance_cost_proxy: The request adapter assigns cost 1 to every supported candidate. Runtime preflight must verify every cost is exactly 1 before treating Maint(M)<=B as |M|<=B. This is an additive experimental proxy, not physical PostgreSQL maintenance cost.

forest10.nominal_priority: the frozen candidate order, used as one fixed global priority order for every task
forest10.loss_input_note: Positive pre-clamp observations and the archived corrected-log model are reused unchanged; no new observations or fit are permitted.

census13.nominal_priority: the predeclared schema_order from the frozen plan; do not substitute another of the archived permutations
census13.loss_input_note: Reuse only the frozen valid-only observations and the clamped-log-v2 transform. Preserve raw zero observations; apply max(1,x) only in the already-frozen coefficient construction. No refit or model change is permitted.

scientific_model.outer_decision: an unordered resource set M with additive unit-cost proxy and Maint(M)<=B; do not force budget fill
scientific_model.loss: the existing nonnegative task loss and frozen rational coefficients, summed over all 10000 valid tasks with unit weights
scientific_model.nominal: for each task, scan all selected eligible candidates in the one archived global priority order and greedily accept a candidate when both endpoints remain free; evaluate the resulting deterministic maximal matching
scientific_model.pess: for each task independently, maximize its loss over every inclusion-maximal matching in the complete selected eligible candidate graph, then sum the task-wise maxima
scientific_model.loss_formula: For a task and admissible matching S, the frozen rational loss is abs(alpha_i + sum_{e in S} b_e,i); task weight is 1. Forest10 retains its positive pre-clamp corrected-log inputs, while Census13 retains the distinct clamped-log-v2 transform.
not_allowed: maximum-cardinality matching in place of maximal matching
one shared global matching policy across tasks
candidate trimming, subsampling, refitting, changed costs or a changed priority order
swaps, restarts, warm starts or forced budget use
a claim that the prescribed PESS family contains every real PostgreSQL scheme
scientific_model.arithmetic_and_claims: Advisor add_only_greedy uses exact Fraction fixed-set objective evaluations. The outer decision is heuristic and carries no global-optimum guarantee. Any PESS comparison is certified only within the frozen model and prescribed maximal-matching family.

greedy_rule.each_round: evaluate every remaining budget-feasible candidate with the objective's exact fixed-set Fraction value; choose the candidate with largest strictly positive objective reduction
greedy_rule.tie_break: ascending candidate_id, shared by both objectives and independent of the Nominal scheme priority order
stop: best exact improvement is zero or negative
greedy_rule.round_commit: a round is committed only after every remaining budget-feasible candidate has a completed exact evaluation
greedy_rule.optimality_label: add_only_greedy_heuristic; never report outer global optimality

outcome_interpretation.practical_threshold: none introduced; report the exact Fraction contrast. Different sets with zero PESS gap are policy disagreement with an objective tie, not a positive PESS regret result.
outcome_interpretation.positive_pess_regret_scope: PESS loss of the Nominal greedy set minus PESS loss of the PESS greedy set; relative only to the PESS heuristic incumbent, never global regret

case_order.serial_order: Forest10 then Census13; within each dataset B=0,2,3,4,5; within each budget Nominal then PESS
case_order.same_envelope: Both objectives for a dataset/budget pair use the same host, one process, memory cap, outer wall deadline and max_evaluations. PESS alone also receives the explicitly reported inner subset-check cap.

resource_limits.host: one designated host for the whole serial sequence; record hostname, CPU model and logical CPU allocation before a future authorized run
resource_limits.outer_hard_wall_enforcement: one OS cgroup/systemd scope per case; record effective limits and exit status
resource_limits.memory_limit_enforcement: one OS cgroup/systemd scope per case; record peak RSS and memory limit outcome
resource_limits.fixed_set_evaluation_cap_formula: 1 + sum_{j=0}^{B-1}(N-j), where N is the complete candidate count; shared by Nominal and PESS
resource_limits.pess_inner_subset_cap_formula: T * (1 + sum_{j=0}^{B-1}(N-j)*2^(j+1)), where T=10000; derived from at most B unit-cost additions and all eligible candidates present in every task, not from observed outcomes

fixed_set_cross_evaluation.evaluations: after both objective runs complete, evaluate each of the two selected sets under both exact objectives: two Nominal fixed-set values and two task-wise PESS fixed-set values
fixed_set_cross_evaluation.pess_inner_subset_cap_per_contrast: 2*T*2^B, where the two sets each contain at most B unit-cost resources

resource_limits.cap_reached: INCOMPLETE; do not publish a last completed prefix as a completed policy selection

stopping_and_failure.on_any_case_failure: Mark the case INCOMPLETE, preserve the failure/status/counters, stop the remaining serial sequence, and request review. Do not retry, increase a limit, switch backend, drop tasks or use a partial round.
failure_conditions: input, source, hash, model-version, schema, candidate, cost, priority or task-count mismatch
timeout, memory cap, max_evaluations cap or PESS subset cap
exception, missing or duplicated task, missing coefficient, nonfinite or uncertified objective
heuristic_incomplete, interrupted greedy round or absent complete response
cross-objective exact re-evaluation cannot be completed or certified
stopping_and_failure.cross_evaluation_failure: Mark the dataset/budget contrast INCONCLUSIVE, record the failing evaluation, and stop remaining dependent runs; never substitute a partial value.

result_record_format.encoding: UTF-8 JSON Lines; exact Fractions use canonical strings such as 0, 3 or -2/7
result_record_format.case_record_schema: ess-issue87-greedy-case-v1; one record for each dataset/objective/budget

case_field_types_and_semantics.model_version: string from the frozen input pin
case_field_types_and_semantics.task_count: integer; exactly 10000 for a future complete case
case_field_types_and_semantics.candidate_count: integer; exactly 45 or 78 for a future complete case
case_field_types_and_semantics.nominal_priority_order_sha256: 64-character lowercase hexadecimal string for Nominal; null for PESS
case_field_types_and_semantics.termination_reason: string from the pinned Advisor response, or failure identifier
case_field_types_and_semantics.selected_ids: sorted string array for COMPLETE; null for INCOMPLETE
case_field_types_and_semantics.last_completed_prefix: string array for audit only; never treated as the selected policy after an incomplete round
case_field_types_and_semantics.addition_order: string array from the complete greedy result; null for INCOMPLETE
case_field_types_and_semantics.objective_fraction: canonical exact Fraction string or null
case_field_types_and_semantics.objective_trace: ordered array of {candidate_id, objective_before_fraction, objective_after_fraction, improvement_fraction}
case_field_types_and_semantics.resource_overlap: object with the four integer fields defined below
case_field_types_and_semantics.wall_seconds: nonnegative number measured around the case process
case_field_types_and_semantics.peak_rss_bytes: nonnegative integer measured by the outer process monitor
case_field_types_and_semantics.resource_limits: object containing the configured and effective time, memory, process and work caps
case_field_types_and_semantics.input_hashes: object mapping pinned source paths and model artifacts to SHA-256 strings
case_field_types_and_semantics.advisor_source_commit: 40-character commit SHA; must equal the protocol pin
case_field_types_and_semantics.research_adapter_source_sha256: 64-character lowercase hexadecimal string; must equal the protocol pin
case_field_types_and_semantics.issue87_run_source_commit: 40-character research checkout HEAD used to build the request
case_field_types_and_semantics.request_sha256: 64-character lowercase hexadecimal SHA-256 of the exact UTF-8 schema-v1 request bytes sent to the pinned CLI, including any trailing newline
case_field_types_and_semantics.response_sha256: 64-character lowercase hexadecimal SHA-256 of the exact UTF-8 Advisor response bytes captured from the pinned CLI, including any trailing newline

result_record_format.case_status: COMPLETE only for heuristic_completed with a complete exact response; otherwise INCOMPLETE. On INCOMPLETE, selected_ids is null and any prefix is audit-only.

resource_overlap_fields.global_overlapping_endpoint_count: number of distinct endpoints incident to at least two selected resources
resource_overlap_fields.global_overlapping_resource_pair_count: number of unordered selected-resource pairs sharing an endpoint
resource_overlap_fields.task_applicable_overlap_incidence_count: sum over tasks of endpoints incident to at least two selected resources that are eligible for that task
resource_overlap_fields.tasks_with_task_applicable_overlap: number of tasks with at least one such endpoint

result_record_format.contrast_record_schema: ess-issue87-greedy-contrast-v1; one record per dataset/budget after Nominal, PESS and all four exact fixed-set evaluations are complete

contrast_field_types_and_semantics.nominal_selected_ids: sorted string array or null if Nominal was incomplete
contrast_field_types_and_semantics.pess_selected_ids: sorted string array or null if PESS was incomplete
contrast_field_types_and_semantics.same_set: boolean or null if either case was incomplete
contrast_field_types_and_semantics.nominal_selected_count: integer or null if Nominal was incomplete
contrast_field_types_and_semantics.pess_selected_count: integer or null if PESS was incomplete
contrast_field_types_and_semantics.nominal_budget_used_fraction: canonical exact Fraction string or null if Nominal was incomplete
contrast_field_types_and_semantics.pess_budget_used_fraction: canonical exact Fraction string or null if PESS was incomplete
contrast_field_types_and_semantics.*_fraction: canonical exact Fraction string or null when the relevant evaluation was incomplete
contrast_field_types_and_semantics.pess_gap_nominal_minus_pess_incumbent_fr: PESS(Nominal set) - PESS(PESS greedy set), exact Fraction; not global regret
contrast_field_types_and_semantics.cross_evaluation_work: object with exact fixed-set call, matching-subset, maximal-matching and wall-time counts
contrast_field_types_and_semantics.failure_reason: null for COMPLETE; concrete failure/censoring reason otherwise

result_record_format.retention: Keep one authoritative protocol/config, compact case and contrast JSONL records after separately authorized execution, the analysis code and one concise findings/limitations report. Do not copy source datasets or create duplicate summary artifacts.

historical_reference.use: The archived exact B=0/2/3 selections and objectives are a future input/model sanity reference only. Greedy is heuristic and need not reproduce exact globally optimal sets.

required_before_any_full_valid_solver_ca: independent review and merge of this protocol PR
a separate explicit researcher execution decision
a reviewed run entrypoint that checks the exact protocol/input/backend pins and resource controls
verification that the runtime adapter, all 10000 tasks, complete candidate universe, model hashes and unit costs match this config
